day5_lunch_chase_1.text: *I ran. Burst through the classroom door. Didn't look back.*

day5_lunch_chase_2.text: *The hallway. Fluorescent lights flicker. Footsteps echo. Mine. Yuna's. Two sets.*

day5_lunch_chase_3.text:
*Yuna pants and stumbles, growing heavier on my shoulder.*

Watch your feet. Lean on me. Don't talk, just breathe. I'll take smaller steps.

day5_lunch_chase_3a.text:
*I grip harder at the thought of running faster alone.*

Your grip hurts. Don't let go—just a little looser.

day5_lunch_chase_5.text:
*The broadcast echoes through the hallway. Ms. Eunsu's voice comes from everywhere. From the walls. From the ceiling. From beneath my feet.*

I can hear you from the walls too. Where are you, Miss? If you're going to block my way, show yourself. Your voice won't make me turn back.

day5_lunch_chase_6.text: ...All the doors are locked. Come back.

day5_lunch_chase_7.text: *...No. There is still one place left. The place Seolhwa kept pointing to.*

day5_lunch_chase_8.text: *The sealed hallway. A fork. Left — the main building. Right — the old wing.*

day5_lunch_chase_10.text: *Footsteps come from the left, then from the right as well. Five seconds. Both sides are getting closer.*

day5_lunch_left_1.text: *End of the hallway. Sea is standing there.*

day5_lunch_left_2.text: *Arms spread, blocking the way. The sleeves of her uniform are trembling. The red glow of the emergency light illuminates only half of Sea's face.*

day5_lunch_left_3.text:
*I could push past, but my knees freeze.*

Why stop? How can I move if you just look at me? Tell me if you're going.

day5_lunch_left_5.text: *Her voice cracks. The ends of her sleeves are already wet.*

day5_lunch_left_5b.text: *Sea shakes her head and stays in front of the door.*

day5_lunch_left_6.text: I can't move aside. Not this time.

day5_lunch_left_7.text:
*Sea clenches both hands into fists. Her knuckles are white.*

What will you do this time? Think blocking me will make me stay?

day5_lunch_left_9.text: But if you go through that door, the next day there's a stranger standing in front of me.

day5_lunch_left_10.text: The name tag changes, the hairstyle changes, and we start over from the first hello.

day5_lunch_left_11.text: The time you said 'hello' on your first day. It was 8:12 every time.

day5_lunch_left_12.text: That’s why I was at the front gate every time.

day5_lunch_left_13.text: *Clang. The steel door on the 1st floor of the main building rattles. Someone is coming up. Footsteps echo on the stairs.*

day5_lunch_left_14.text: That's not smiling at you. It's a stranger who doesn't know you smiling.

day5_lunch_left_15.text:
*Sea opens her mouth, then shuts it.*

You'll still know who I am if you let me past. Who's making me forget my name?

day5_lunch_left_20.text: There are nail marks on that corner. Twelve lines.

day5_lunch_left_22.text: Nobody counts them. Only I do.

day5_lunch_left_23.text: After you passed by, I rubbed it with my sleeve. Even after I erased it, the mark stayed.

day5_lunch_left_24.text: And by the next morning, the name tag on your desk was different.

day5_lunch_left_25.text: ...Do I have to get out of the way this time too?

day5_lunch_left_choice.text:
*Bang, bang, bang. Footsteps on the stairs draw closer. Sea looks toward the sound but doesn’t move aside.*

*An unfamiliar sentence appears in the middle of my thoughts.*

***`[RETENTION APPROVED]`***
choices: "I'm sorry. But I have to go."

day5_lunch_left_c1_1.text:
*Sea presses her sleeve to her eyes and moves aside.*

Thanks. I'm not leaving because I don't want to see you. Don't ask me back. Let me pass.

day5_lunch_left_c1_2.text: ...I'll get out of the way this time too.

day5_lunch_left_c1_3.text: At the next door, I won't move aside. That's where I'll stop you.

day5_lunch_left_c1_5.text: *Footsteps reached the end of the hallway. No time to look back.*

day5_lunch_left_c1_7.text: *Behind me — the sound of someone sinking to the floor. A school uniform brushing against the floor. And — a short, choked breath.*

day5_lunch_left_c2_2.text:
*Sea's eyes go wide. The key ring stops dead in her palm.*

Don't pretend you didn't hear. I'm asking you to come. I don't want to leave you here. Will you come with me?

day5_lunch_left_c2_3.text: If we go outside, will you still know my name?

day5_lunch_left_c2_5.text: ...I don't even know what it's like out there.

day5_lunch_left_c2_6.text:
*Sea looks down at a red line on the inside of her wrist, pressed in like a mark from the council room keyring. Even after turning toward the window, she says nothing for a while.*

If you don't know, let's find out together. Waiting here won't tell us.

day5_lunch_left_c2_7.text: There aren't hallways like this out there, are there?

day5_lunch_left_c2_9.text: There's no way to know. But I'll go anyway.

day5_lunch_left_c2_10.text: The door will be open, right?

day5_lunch_left_c3_1.text: *...My knees give out. I sink to the floor in front of Sea. My toes won't leave the ground.*

day5_lunch_right_1.text: *Running down the old building's hallway — I stopped. The footsteps disappeared. The ones chasing from behind. The ones echoing on the stairs. All of them.*

day5_lunch_right_2.text: *A thick fire shutter is lowered between the old and main buildings. Fresh fingerprint smears mark the handle. The siren is muffled beyond the shutter.*

day5_lunch_right_3.text: *I squeezed under the shutter. Standing up — it's quiet. The only quiet place in a sealed school.*

day5_lunch_right_4.text: *The infirmary door is open. Only one fluorescent light is on; the other sockets are empty.*

day5_lunch_right_5.text:
*Riin stands in front of the cabinet in ordinary clothes, without her white coat. Her bag is already on top of the cabinet.*

You took off the coat. Getting ready to leave? Don't leave me here. I need out too.

day5_lunch_right_6.text: *Syringes lined up in a row. Label: 'Memory Erasure Protocol #13'. Needles glint beneath the fluorescent light.*

day5_lunch_right_8.text: ...Are you here to stop me too?

day5_lunch_right_9.text:
*Riin picks up a syringe.*

Why take that? Don't call it a checkup again. I won't lie down here.

day5_lunch_right_10.text:
*I back into the doorframe. There is nowhere left to go. Nurse Riin raises the syringe. A single drop of liquid falls from the tip of the needle, and my knees go weak.*

Don't come closer.

day5_lunch_right_12.text:
*Riin deliberately takes her time setting the syringe on the sink. Clink. Metal strikes ceramic.*

Why were you waiting here?

day5_lunch_right_13.text: I'm not here to stop you.

day5_lunch_pills_1.text: *Riin holds out both hands. A black pill rests in one palm and a pink pill in the other.*

day5_lunch_pills_2.text: I’m not explaining. Just swallow one.

day5_lunch_pills_pink_1.text: *I swallow the pink pill, and my throat grows hot. A sweet taste lingers on my tongue.*

day5_lunch_pills_pink_2.text: *The infirmary ceiling blurs. I reach out to brace myself against the floor, but somehow I am holding the cold school gate. Crushed petals are scattered at my feet.*

day5_lunch_pills_pink_3.text: *The school bell rings beyond the gate. I look down at my uniform sleeve.*

day5_lunch_pills_black_1.text: *I swallow the black pill, and my throat turns cold. Riin lowers her hands and turns toward the cabinet.*

day5_lunch_right_14.text:
*Riin opens the cabinet. Medicine bottles stand in rows.*

What’s in those bottles? Show me. I can’t just trust your word now.

day5_lunch_right_15.text:
*She opens the medicine bottle and holds it to the tip of her nose. After a brief sniff, she swallows one sip.*

You drinking it doesn't tell me what it is. Say it.

day5_lunch_right_16.text: Don't look at the label. Look at the back.

day5_lunch_right_18.text: Glucose solution. A little electrolyte. I only matched the color and viscosity.

day5_lunch_right_20.text:
*She rubs the medicine bottle’s label with her thumb. An ordinary hospital IV code shows through beneath the added label.*

There's another label. Did you put something else in from the start?

day5_lunch_right_22.text: Since the seventh cycle. Since Lee Seolhwa disappeared.

day5_lunch_right_23.text: Normal dose on the record. IV code on the bottle. I adjusted the numbers on the blood draw sheet.

day5_lunch_right_24.text: The S-13 record has almost no active fields filled in. Blank fields get skipped in review.

day5_lunch_right_26.text: The seventh time. When Lee Seolhwa was dragged away, she kept saying one thing to the end.

day5_lunch_right_28.text: 'Please don't touch that person.' Even while being dragged away, that was all she kept repeating.

day5_lunch_right_29.text: After that, I split the chart in two. One for submission, one for the truth.

day5_lunch_right_30.text: That’s why your hand found the way first. The hallway, the stairs, even her name.

day5_lunch_right_32.text: *Nurse Riin took a key from her pocket. A small silver key. The grooves on its surface are polished smooth from handling.*

day5_lunch_right_33.text:
*The hand offering the silver key doesn't shake.*

Which door? I need to know before I take it.

day5_lunch_right_34.text: Old wing, 3rd floor. The emergency exit Seolhwa found. This key opens it.

day5_lunch_right_35.text: ...Eunsu doesn't know this key. After the 7th time I changed the locks.

day5_lunch_right_36.text: *The shutter control panel display flashes `LOCAL OVERRIDE - R.IN`. On the student safety app map, only the right hallway of the old wing is grayed out and empty.*

day5_lunch_right_37.text: *Bang! The fire shutter shook violently. Someone is pounding from outside. Eunsu, or the 'administration,' has caught up.*

day5_lunch_right_39.text:
*She offers the small silver key. It taps lightly between her fingers.*

I'll take this to the door. I'll still be doubting it there.

day5_lunch_right_choice.text: *The fire shutter rattled again. Metal screaming.*

day5_lunch_right_c1_1.text: *I take the key. Small, cold, silver. It trembles faintly in my hand.*

day5_lunch_right_c2_1.text:
*Riin pauses, then puts the key in my hand and picks up the bag from the top of the cabinet. She is already ready to leave.*

Come with me. At least to the door. Me getting out doesn't end what you did.

day5_lunch_right_c3_2.text:
*She picks up a syringe and injects the inert diluent into her own arm.*

Sticking it in your arm doesn't make me believe you. Not the syringe. Say it.

day5_lunch_right_c3_3.text: ...You saw behind the label. Did you check?

day5_lunch_right_c3_4.text: Doubt me. Include me in that. But the key is real. Go.

day5_lunch_right_c3_5.text:
*Riin smiles briefly and hands me the key.*

I'll take the key. I'll thank you once I'm out.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_1.text: *The staircase up to the 3rd floor of the old wing. Supporting Yuna.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_2.text: *Halfway up the stairs — Seolhwa is standing there.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_3.text: *Yuna's camera shows nothing but the stairs. Outside the lens, Seolhwa stands right before my eyes.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_7.text: *Instead, my left hand grips the railing. Beneath my palm, I feel a shallow scratch where the paint has peeled away.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_8.text: ***“Don’t run. You’ll slip on the second step.”***

day5_lunch_seolhwa_9.text: *It's my handwriting. No—my handwriting from the seventh cycle. There's a tiny star at the end of the note, and another hand beside it.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_11.text: We made it this far before.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_12.text: *When she finishes, the scratches on the stairs catch my eye. A rain-soaked hallway. A cold hand. The third floor of the old wing. An unbroken window.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_13.text:
*I sit on the stairs and hug my knees. I remember the cold that lingered on the bathroom tiles on night 4.*

You were beside me then too. I kept checking you were there.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_16.text: Every time, I greeted you like it was the first. Even though your seat stayed empty.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_17.text: But you still left the writing behind.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_19.text: *There are scratches on the stairwell wall too. Arrows. Numbers. Scraped-out sentences. Every time I see them, the weight in my feet shifts before I can think.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_20.text: Your hand will find the way before anything else.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_21.text: *The moment I saw the arrow on the wall, my ankle twisted first. My palm braced against the left wall.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_22.text: ...So when I saw my left hand back then—

day5_lunch_seolhwa_23.text: Because you always held the left railing.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_24.text: And the thing you kept saying—

day5_lunch_seolhwa_25.text: **Lee Seolhwa.** Don't get that name wrong.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_26.text:
*A glint at the corner of her eye flickers briefly under the fluorescent light. I can't tell if it's moisture or a trick of the light.*

Lee Seolhwa. Can I say it now?

day5_lunch_seolhwa_27.text: ...Today is different. You called my name first.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_28.text: *I blink. For a moment, the scratches on the stairwell wall come into sharp focus.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_29.text: This time, the door is open.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_30.text: *Seolhwa reaches out. A hand I can't touch.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_c1_2.text: I can't go out that door.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_c1_3.text: Once you cross the door, leave only the name behind.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_c2_2.text: *Seolhwa looked at her own hands. Her fingertips are blurry.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_c2_3.text: Once you're out, we won't need the arrows on the walls anymore.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_c2_6.text: This is as far as I go. You open the door.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_1.text: Keep your left hand on the wall.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_2.text:
*Before the words are finished, my hand moves to the wall. A very shallow groove runs beneath the paint, a path only my fingertips can find.*

I can feel it. Can't see it, but I can feel it. Keep following?

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_3.text: *We pass through the dark hallway of the old wing. My fingertips follow grooves in the wall. The shoulder supporting Yuna has gone numb.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_4.text: *The hallway is dark. Every time the cell phone light hits, Seolhwa's outline shakes one beat later.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_6.text: I know the way. Follow me.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_8.text: *A small star mark below the handle. Dust clung to my fingertips. When I opened the door, a narrow staircase appeared between pipes and conduits.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_9.text: *I climbed up. One floor. Two floors. Water leaking from a pipe. Cold.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_10.text: *3rd floor. In front of the emergency exit.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_11.text: *I look back from the doorway. Seolhwa fades from the face down until I can’t see her at all.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_13a.text: *I insert the key. The metal catches once; a moment later, the lock releases.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_13b.text: *I feel along the wall beside me. My fingertips catch the edge of a panel beneath the paint. I pry it up, revealing rusted circuitry. When I lower the lever, sparks fly and the alarm goes off.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_14.text: *The door opened. Outside air rushed in. Cold, dry late-night air. The smell of medicine in my throat washed away a little.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_15.text: *The emergency exit is empty on Yuna’s camera screen. Only before my own eyes does dark brown hair sway in the wind.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_1.text: *From behind — footsteps. Coming up the stairs.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_2.text: *Footsteps climb the stairs one at a time. No running. No sound of anyone catching their breath.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_3.text: *The footsteps grow closer. The sound of dress shoes hitting concrete. Ms. Eunsu's shoes.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_4.text: *Stopped. At the top of the stairs.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_5.text: *Ms. Eunsu appeared. Out of breath. Hair disheveled. — Not the composed appearance from the classroom.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_6.text: *She opens and closes her mouth, then speaks in her usual voice.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_7.text: {name}. Stop there. The emergency exit side is a restricted area.

day5_lunch_eunsu_8.text:
*As I back away, Ms. Eunsu brings the syringe in front of her body. The needle catches the emergency light.*

Taking me back with that again? Put it down before telling me to stop.

day5_lunch_eunsu_9.text:
*Sweat beads on Ms. Eunsu's forehead, and dark circles shadow her eyes.*

*Cold air from the emergency exit passes between us.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_10.text: The record sheets were all soaked.

day5_lunch_eunsu_11.text: There were rainy days, and there were snowy days.

day5_lunch_eunsu_12.text: But the last line was always the same. `Recovery complete`.

day5_lunch_eunsu_13.text: This time, I didn't want to write that line.

day5_lunch_eunsu_14.text: The menu, the seat, the hallway. I erased the boxes you hated one by one. In the report, I wrote that you had quieted down.

day5_lunch_eunsu_15.text:
*Eunsu steps closer.*

Don't come closer. If you hate writing that line, don't write it.

day5_lunch_eunsu_16.text: ...This time too, my hands shook the moment you walked into the classroom. The procedure was the same.

day5_lunch_eunsu_17.text: Every time you checked me with eyes seeing me for the first time, another name appeared on the attendance sheet.

day5_lunch_eunsu_18.text:
*Ms. Eunsu steps away from the emergency exit and stops about 3 meters from me.*

You hated when I didn't recognize you. Erase me again and it happens again.

day5_lunch_eunsu_19.text:
*Ms. Eunsu slowly draws a syringe from her pocket, as though displaying it to me.*

*The liquid inside glints under the fluorescent light. Small letters on the label read `RESET / S-13`. A single drop hangs from the needle.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_21.text: One shot and it's over. You just have to keep your eyes closed.

day5_lunch_eunsu_22.text: I'll put you in the next attendance book under a new name.

day5_lunch_eunsu_24.text: *Wind comes in through the emergency exit gap. The smell of classroom dust briefly wafts away.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_26.text:
*A drop of liquid falls from the syringe’s tip onto the floor. Ms. Eunsu does not lower her hand.*

Would you put it down if I returned? Don't call me back while holding it.

day5_lunch_eunsu_27.text:
*Tears run down to her chin and fall. Ms. Eunsu keeps holding the syringe.*

You're crying, but your hand hasn't moved. What am I supposed to trust?

day5_lunch_eunsu_28.text: *Wind from the exit gets under my shirt. I hear only our breathing; Yuna stays motionless against the wall.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_29.text: *I look back and forth between the needle tip and the door handle.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_30.text: *I just need to push her away and run. That hand has no strength to hold me. But my feet have already turned toward the classroom.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_31.text: *Ms. Eunsu takes one more step. Now she is within arm's reach.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_32.text: *Seolhwa stands at the bottom of the stairs behind the teacher. Her gaze is fixed on me.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_final.text:
*The screen border flashes red. The clock reads 22:58. Two minutes left.*

*The choice text appears late, one character at a time. Only the second button completes first.*

***`...Please erase me.`***

*The other buttons follow after a delay.*

day5_lunch_final_true.text: *I decide not to erase my memories.*
